description_en: Queries the consumption status of a consumer group
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka get-consumer-progress --instance-id alikafka_pre-cn-mp919o4v0000 --consumer-id kafka-test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --hide-last-timestamp true --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetConsumerProgress

parameters.help_en: The name of the consumer group
parameters.name: consumer_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to hide the \`LastTimestamp\` parameter. The default value is false. Set this parameter to true for better performance.

If you set this parameter to true, -1 is returned for the \`LastTimestamp\` parameter. Otherwise, a specific value is returned. This parameter is supported only for topics of cloud storage on provisioned instances.

This operation processes a large amount of data and consumes a high degree of performance. Set this parameter to true to reduce the processing time
parameters.help_zh:
是否隐藏 LastTimestamp，默认值为 false，建议设置为 true。



若设置为 true，则返回参数中的 LastTimestamp 会返回为 -1，反之则返回具体的值。仅支持预留实例云存储类型的 Topic。
该接口处理数据较多，比较损耗性能，建议设置为 true，可加快处理时间
parameters.name: hide_last_timestamp

Code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates that the request is successful

LastTimestamp.description_en:
The latest time when a message was stored. This time is calculated based on the consumer offsets of all topics in the consumer group.

This parameter is not supported for topics on Serverless instances or topics that use local storage on provisioned instances. In these cases, -1 is returned.

For topics that use cloud storage on provisioned instances, this parameter returns the message creation timestamp. This happens only after you submit the consumer offset for a consumer group that was created in the console or by an API call. If the message has no creation timestamp, -1 is returned
LastTimestamp.description_zh:
该 Group 所有消费位点所对应的消息数据的最大存储时间。

Serverless实例所有 Topic 类型暂不支持、预留实例的 Local 类型的 Topic 暂不支持。值统一返回 -1。
只有预留实例的云存储类型的 Topic，通过控制台或 OpenApi 创建的 Group 提交消费位点后，才会返回对应消息的创建时间戳。如果对应的消息不存在创建时间戳，则返回-1

RebalanceInfoList.description_en:
The rebalancing details of the consumer group.

This parameter is no longer returned. To query rebalancing details, call the ListRebalanceInfo operation
RebalanceInfoList.description_zh:
该 Group 的 Rebalance 详情。


该接口不会再返回此字段，需要查询 Rebalance 详情请使用 ListRebalanceInfo 接口

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the subscriber group

LastRebalanceTimestamp.description_en: The time when the latest rebalancing event occurred. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
LastRebalanceTimestamp.description_zh: 本轮 Rebalance 发生的时间。单位 s

Reason.description_en: The reason for the rebalancing event

RebalanceSuccess.description_en: Indicates whether a new member joined the consumer group during the latest rebalancing event
RebalanceSuccess.description_zh: 本轮 Rebalance 是否有新成员加入消费组

RebalanceTimeConsuming.description_en: The duration of the latest rebalancing event. Unit: ms
RebalanceTimeConsuming.description_zh: 本轮 Rebalance 的持续时间。单位 ms

TopicList.description_en: The list of consumption progress for each topic in the consumer group
TopicList.description_zh: 此Group对应的每个Topic的消费进度列表

LastTimestamp.description_en:
The latest time when a message was stored. This time is calculated based on the consumer offsets of all topics to which the consumer group subscribes.

This parameter is not supported for topics on Serverless instances or topics that use local storage on provisioned instances. In these cases, -1 is returned.

For topics that use cloud storage on provisioned instances, this parameter returns the message creation timestamp. This happens only after you submit the consumer offset for a consumer group that was created in the console or by an API call. If the message has no creation timestamp, -1 is returned
LastTimestamp.description_zh:
该 Group 所订阅 Topic 的所有消费位点所对应的消息数据的最大存储时间。


Serverless实例所有 Topic 类型暂不支持、预留实例的 Local 类型的 Topic 暂不支持。值统一返回 -1。
只有预留实例的云存储类型的 Topic，通过控制台或 OpenApi 创建的 Group 提交消费位点后，才会返回对应消息的创建时间戳。如果对应的消息不存在创建时间戳，则返回-1

ClientId.description_en: The client ID of the application

ClientIp.description_en: The IP address of the client

LastTimestamp.description_en:
The time when the message at the consumer offset of the partition was stored.

This parameter is not supported for topics on Serverless instances or topics that use local storage on provisioned instances. In these cases, -1 is returned.

For topics that use cloud storage on provisioned instances, this parameter returns the message creation timestamp. This happens only after you submit the consumer offset for a consumer group that was created in the console or by an API call. If the message has no creation timestamp, -1 is returned
LastTimestamp.description_zh:
该分区的消费位点所对应的消息数据的存储时间。


Serverless实例所有 Topic 类型暂不支持、预留实例的 Local 类型的 Topic 暂不支持。值统一返回 -1。
只有预留实例的云存储类型的 Topic，通过控制台或 OpenApi 创建的 Group 提交消费位点后，才会返回对应消息的创建时间戳。如果对应的消息不存在创建时间戳，则返回-1

TotalDiff.description_en: The total number of unconsumed messages in all topics. This value is the message accumulation
